derivation: or חַכְמוֹת; collateral forms of H2451 (חׇכְמָה);

occurrences.text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
